suggestions.title: Add FAQPage schema for answer-led AI queries
suggestions.rationale: A concise, maintained FAQ can expose high-intent questions and direct answers even when no current markup defect is detected.

suggested_action.summary: Publish a user-facing FAQ and add valid FAQPage JSON-LD that matches the visible questions and answers. Review it whenever the product or policy changes.

suggestions.title: Publish an llms.txt usage policy
suggestions.rationale: An explicit policy can clarify preferred AI-readable resources and usage expectations beyond merely making an llms.txt file reachable.

suggested_action.summary: Maintain /llms.txt with key canonical pages, concise content descriptions, and an explicit usage policy for AI retrieval systems.

suggestions.title: Use one canonical Organization @id across the site
suggestions.rationale: A stable entity identifier helps AI systems connect organisation facts, products, articles, and author profiles across separate pages.

suggested_action.summary: Define a canonical Organization JSON-LD @id (for example, https://example.com/#organization) and reference that same ID from related structured-data blocks.

suggestions.title: Add Article dateModified signals to maintained editorial pages
suggestions.rationale: Explicit modification dates make ongoing stewardship visible to AI systems even when currently available date signals pass the audit.

suggested_action.summary: For editorial pages, include accurate Article datePublished and dateModified fields in JSON-LD and update dateModified whenever material content changes.
